name: RR Dashin Thru Fire

sire: By JESS FIRE ME SI 98 (2019). 2 wins, $242,442, 2nd Ruidoso Fut. [G1], fnl in Los Alamitos Super Derby [G1]. Brother to JESS WALKING THRU SI 92 (Champion), FIRE AND SASS SI 93, SASSY ON FIRE SI 103. Half-brother to SASS ME BLUE SI 94 (Champion), SASSALITICAL SI 102, JESS BEING VALIANT SI 94, JESS MY DYNASTY SI 102, VALIANT JESS SI 99. His first foals are 2-year-olds of 2026. Son of winner Walk Thru Fire SI 92; sire of 92 stakes winners, 10 champions, including HEZA DASHA FIRE SI 105 (World Champion).
